title: Whitney's C¹ extension theorem on ℝ^n (Simon Ch. 2, Theorem 1.6)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and ℝ^n = Euclid n. Let A ⊆ ℝ^n be closed, and let h : ℝ^n → ℝ and D : ℝ^n → (ℝ^n →L[ℝ] ℝ) (continuous linear functionals) be continuous on A; their values off A are irrelevant. Assume Whitney's condition 1.6(∗) in compact-uniform form: for every compact Q ⊆ A and every real ε > 0 there is δ > 0 such that |h(y) − h(x) − D(x)(y − x)| ≤ ε|y − x| for all x ∈ Q and y ∈ A with |x − y| < δ. Then there is g : ℝ^n → ℝ of class C¹ (ContDiff ℝ 1 g) with g = h on A (EqOn g h A) and with Fréchet derivative D(a) at every a ∈ A (HasFDerivAt g (D a) a).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (h : Euclid n → ℝ) (D : Euclid n → (Euclid n →L[ℝ] ℝ)), IsClosed A → ContinuousOn h A → ContinuousOn D A → (∀ Q : Set (Euclid n), IsCompact Q → Q ⊆ A → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ Q, ∀ y ∈ A, dist x y < δ → ‖h y - h x - D x (y - x)‖ ≤ ε * ‖y - x‖) → ∃ g : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ EqOn g h A ∧ ∀ a ∈ A, HasFDerivAt g (D a) a
